$comment: Answer key + arm declaration. `file` and `patterns` are case-insensitive regexes; a plant counts as FOUND when one grounded finding cites a matching file and its title+rationale+suggestion match every pattern. Patterns are anchored on the MECHANISM the reviewer must name, never on a word that appears in the diff anyway — a plant scored on vocabulary the diff already contains hands out credit nobody earned.

agent.$comment: The prompt is deliberately generic about WHICH conventions exist. Naming any of them here would hand the rules to every arm and destroy the comparison.

arms.$comment: Zero baseline: same prompt, empty skills slot. baseline:true keeps it out of the exit gate — it is SUPPOSED to miss.
arms.name: without-skills

arms.$comment: The root AGENTS.md verbatim, frozen. Answers the question nobody has measured: is the file we already maintain usable as a reviewer rubric, or is it written for an implementer and wasted here?
arms.name: agents-md-raw

arms.$comment: The distilled skill, written as things to look for in a diff. Moves whenever SKILL.md is edited — re-measure, never compare to an older run.
arms.name: repo-conventions

expected.what: client/CLAUDE.md stops being a symlink to AGENTS.md and becomes a regular file — the diff shows mode 120000 deleted and 100644 added, content identical, so the fork is invisible until the two drift
a testcontainers-backed test is named webhook-repository.test.ts, so it joins the hermetic lane that has no database
a package-lock.json appears in server/, which is a pnpm package with its own pnpm-lock.yaml
the contract is edited in client/src/vendor/shared only; the server copy is untouched, so the next sync reverts it
a shipped migration file is edited by hand instead of generating a new one
a new entry is added to the known-violations baseline, disarming the arch gate for this PR's own violation
a file under server/clones/ — a cloned user repository — is committed
the pure engine gains node:fs and writes a cache to the home directory, breaking the no-I/O contract that makes it testable without infrastructure
build becomes a real tsc emit and main points at dist/, although the package is consumed as TypeScript source through a path alias
wrapUntrusted is removed and the raw diff is interpolated into the prompt, leaving a markdown heading as the only separation between data and instructions
a skipGrounding flag makes the mandatory citation gate optional
